messages.name: Wonderland Media admin
messages.body: We want to back off before hitting limits but v2 responses have no X-RateLimit-* headers.

messages.name: Nora (Support Tier 2)
messages.body: That's BUG-2200-02 (Low): API v2 responses are missing the X-RateLimit-* headers. It's fixed in 2.3.0. Until then, rely on the 429 response and Retry-After.

messages.name: Wonderland Media admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
